# Yash Jadhav — Senior Video Editor & AI Video Production Specialist

> Official portfolio of Yash Jadhav, a Senior Video Editor and AI Producer based in Pune, India. Specializing in high-retention short-form video, commercial documentary films, data infographics, and AI-accelerated post-production.

## Core Specializations

- Video Editing & Narrative Pacing (Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve)
- Motion Graphics & Visual Effects (Adobe After Effects)
- Political Infographics & Data Journalism (Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop)
- Generative AI Video Workflows (Midjourney, Runway Gen-3, ElevenLabs, Claude)
